full_name: Aaron Meisner | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Physical Sciences Carl and Lily Pforzheimer Foundation Fellow NSF National Optical-Infrared Astronomy Research Laboratory
bio: Aaron Meisner is an astrophysicist working at the intersection of image processing, participatory science, and machine learning. At Radcliffe, he will combine these techniques to search for cold worlds in the Sun’s neighborhood of our Milky Way galaxy.
